search_text: published ZDI-08-026 ZDI-CAN-063 CA BrightStor ARCserve Backup XDR Parsing Buffer Overflow Vulnerability 2008-05-19 CVE-2008-2242 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2008-2242 ['Computer Associates'] ['BrightStor ARCserve Server'] This vulnerability allws attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of CA BrightStor ARCserve Backup for Linux. User interaction is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists due to improper bounds checking in the xdr_rwsstring() library function. By sending a long parameter into a daemon using this function to process strings, a stack based buffer overflow occurs, leading to execution of arbitrary code. Computer Associates has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
